title: Ole Miss gets revenge on Lane Kiffin in big win over LSU on night of vulgar chants, high stakes
description: No matter the result, Lane Kiffin's return to Ole Miss was bound to be must-see TV. But it was his former team that got the last laugh.

title: New Jersey mom charged with obstruction after ‘missing’ son found hiding in her crawl space
description: A New Jersey woman was charged with obstruction this week after her missing son was found hiding in a crawl space in her home, authorities confirmed.
